data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims development triangle shows adverse development on the 2021 underwriting year, with the gross cumulative estimate for 2021 moving from 3.752m to 5.817m (USD thousands), representing a prior-year strengthening of approximately $2.065m. No explicit textual prior-year movement figure is provided elsewhere; the movement is derived from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision also includes the estimated cost of claims incurred but not reported (IBNR) at the balance sheet date based on statistical methods and includes adjustments for catastrophes and other significant events, changes in historical trends, economic and social conditions, judicial decisions, and legislation, as necessary.
The provision for claims outstanding is subject to significant variability.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims) using the 2021 column only (the report has only 2021 as an older underwriting year). No explicit gross prior-year movement sentence was provided. All amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD, amounts shown in the financial statements are rounded to the nearest $'000). No per-line-of-business reserve movements are disclosed.
